249 Conjecture Answered; Invitation!

One by one, Lin Fan flipped through the draft papers filled with complicated equations and calculations.

The speed at which Lin Fan wrote was getting faster and faster.

In Teacher Tiantian’s eyes, it was so charming and pleasant.

It was as if this piano piece was full of ups and downs with endless climaxes.

Teacher Tiantian’s breathing even began to become a little hurried, and her beautiful cheeks were flushed.

After writing on nearly 20 pages of draft paper, Lin Fan’s fingers suddenly stopped.

Then, he switched to the ballpoint pen in Teacher Tiantian’s hand and wrote down the last line of calculations: Xs1 +1=(3Xs+1)/2 ^n, so 3n +1 is true!

Lin Fan smiled, “Hail Conjecture, solved.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Teacher Tiantian, who was sitting beside him, leaned her head over.

…

Teacher Tiantian was using her own way to express the excitement in her heart.

When love was deep, it was difficult to control it.

After more than an hour, the two of them slowly separated.

Teacher Tiantian tidied up her clothes.

Then, she turned her gaze back to the draft book filled with calculations and exclaimed, “Lin Fan, you actually proved the Hail Conjecture!”

After saying that, Teacher Tiantian could not help but look at Lin Fan with an extremely passionate gaze.

“Lin Fan, when did you start researching the Hail Conjecture?”

“The last time we met,” Lin Fan said.

“Yesterday… Yesterday?” Teacher Tiantian said.

“Yeah.” Lin Fan nodded.

Yesterday morning, Lin Fan said that he was more interested in driving through DiDi.

In the future, he might be interested in the Hail Conjecture.

Then…

After a day, he directly proved the Hail Conjecture?

One had to know…

The Hail Conjecture was a super difficult problem that had stumped the entire world for nearly a hundred years!

In the end, Lin Fan only used one day to solve it?

What kind of genius was he?

At this moment, in Teacher Tiantian’s eyes, Lin Fan seemed to be emitting an incomparably dazzling light. He was so mesmerizing.

“Lin Fan,” Teacher Tiantian called out softly.

“What’s wrong?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

Teacher Tiantian did not say anything. She just moved her head closer.

This time, the two of them slowly separated when a patrolling security guard appeared outside the corridor.

However, their separation was only temporary.

Lin Fan went to Teacher Tiantian’s house.

…

The next day.

Since it was the weekend, neither of them had to go to school.

Lin Fan and Hu Tian sat together and ate their breakfast leisurely.

“Lin Fan, which magazine do you want to publish the solution to Hail Conjecture on?” Hu Tian asked.

Lin Fan took a mouthful of noodles and said, “Publish it? It’s too troublesome. I only proved it out of interest. If you want to publish it, just publish it.”

When Hu Tian heard this, she felt both helpless and touched.

If it was someone else who solved such a world-class problem, they would definitely be ecstatic.

After that, they would analyze it again and again to see which magazine they should submit to.

However, Lin Fan was so calm. He even handed over the solution to her and asked her to submit it.

If she had any ill intentions, this huge achievement would completely belong to her.

“Alright, I’ll submit it to Annual Mathematics for you,” Hu Tian said.

Lin Fan nodded his head nonchalantly and finished the last mouthful of broth. He praised, “Your food is getting more and more delicious!”

“If you like it, eat more,” Hu Tian said happily.

After chatting for a while, Lin Fan drove the Rolls-Royce Phantom toward the Coiling Dragon Villa.

In the past, the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex was located closest to the lake. It was a villa that occupied a huge area.

Now, it was empty.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan smiled and said in satisfaction, “Wang Shengli is quite efficient. He took away all the bricks and stones. This is very suitable for planting tea leaves.”

After saying that, he took the hoe and shovel that he had bought earlier and scattered the Spiritual Tea Seeds that he had obtained from the golden packet. He also watered them with the appropriate amount of water.

Just like that, Lin Fan continued to sow and water the seeds in the Coiling Dragon Villa. Two days passed very leisurely and comfortably.

After ordinary tea leaves were planted, even if they were carefully taken care of, given the best fertilizer, and had sufficient water…

There would definitely not be any changes in two days.

However, the Spiritual Tea Seeds had sprouted.

At this moment, standing in the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex and looking at the sky lake, Lin Fan could see a green scene full of vitality.

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was a call from President Ma of Penguin.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Mr. Lin, how was your weekend?” As soon as he picked up the phone, President Ma’s gentle voice came from the other end.

Lin Fan said, “I planted tea seeds and watered them. It was relaxing.”

“I didn’t expect you to be someone who likes the rural life…” President Ma was a little surprised.

Lin Fan smiled, “What kind of person did you think I was?”

President Ma thought for a moment and said, “Generally speaking, young people like you are interested in lively parties and exciting sports. Or a challenging career…”

Lin Fan smiled. “Compared to these, I would rather lie down.”

After the two of them exchanged pleasantries, President Ma finally revealed the purpose of the call.

“By the way, Mr. Lin, Penguin Group has opened a new company in Jiangbei City. I wonder if you’re free to go with me tomorrow?”

Lin Fan remembered that he was the second largest shareholder of Penguin Group, but he had never been to the headquarters of Penguin Group.

Of course, Lin Fan did not want to go to Yang City to see Penguin Group’s headquarters.

If he did not go to the headquarters, then the branch in Jiangbei… Taking a look around seemed possible.

Lin Fan replied, “Okay, I’ll go with you tomorrow.”

“That’s great!” President Ma said happily. “To be honest, I’ve been missing the food in Jiangbei ever since I left. Mr. Lin, you must bring me out to eat again tomorrow!”

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course!”

The two of them chatted for a while before hanging up.

Then, Lin Fan sent a request for leave to Sun Yaodong.

Regarding this…

Sun Yaodong did not hesitate at all, nor did he ask for any reason. He directly chose to approve it.
